companyNotes: Network caveat: this run's egress proxy blocked ALL direct page fetches (linkedin.com, careers.mastercard.com, and even aggregators like builtin.com) — every listing above was captured from search-engine results of the careers.mastercard.com domain, so no description was read, no posted date/deadline confirmed, and every visa flag defaults to Not Mentioned. A future run with network access should re-verify each URL and read descriptions. Structure of Mastercard early-careers hiring: hub pages are careers.mastercard.com/us/en/early-careers, /early-careers/internships, /early-careers/launch, /student-opportunities/ and /student-fulltime-jobs/. Launch is the flagship 18-month global graduate program (two 9-month rotations, 50+ countries, ~850 hires/yr) for recent Bachelor's/Master's graduates; internships (for students graduating the following year) pipeline into it. Cycle timing observed: as of 2026-08-21 the 2027 cycle is live in Australia/New Zealand (five Launch roles, reqs R-255330–R-284621) and just opening in the US (first Summer 2027 intern req R-286204, Arlington); UK, Ireland, Canada and US 2027 Launch/intern postings are not yet indexed — expect them around Sep–Oct 2026, worth re-checking. Many 2026-cycle postings (reqs ~R-255xxx–R-257xxx: Launch 2026 London/Dublin/Toronto/NYC, Summer 2026 interns US/Toronto/Johannesburg, Johannesburg Winter 2026 interns) still appear in search indexes but those programs have already started, so they were excluded as almost certainly closed. South Africa (Johannesburg, Melrose Arch office) runs both Summer and Winter internship programs plus Launch — a recent 'Associate Analyst, Account Management' Johannesburg posting was seen only on an aggregator (no company URL recoverable), so it was omitted; re-check next run.
